name: MVEA 63rd Annual Conference
venue: Embassy Suites Downtown Omaha Old Market
conf_dates_note: Sessions begin around 1pm Thursday and conclude at noon Saturday
deadline_note: Submission deadline extended to September 10, 2026. Call closed. Completed paper must be sent to the discussant by October 23, 2026.
submission_requirements: Paper abstracts via online form; arranged session proposals via separate form. Papers in all stages of development welcome
registration_fee: In person: USD 75 members / USD 105 non-members / USD 40 full-time students (by Oct 23, 2026; USD 90 / 120 / 45 after). Virtual: USD 275 / 305 / 150 (USD 290 / 320 / 175 after)
membership_required: Not required; members receive discounted registration (USD 40 per year)
keynotes: Edward Balistreri (University of Nebraska-Lincoln); Cory Koedel (University of Missouri) - preliminary
journal: All papers presented are eligible for publication consideration in the Journal of Economic Insight
